name: Ecogreen Enerji Holding Anonim Sirketi
summary: Ecogreen Enerji Holding Anonim Sirketi, through its subsidiaries, generates and sells electricity from renewable energy sources. The company operates solar, wind, biogas, and biomass power plants. It also produces and sells organic, organomineral, and chemical fertilizers; as well as engages in project development and contracting activities. The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Denizli, Turkey.
